summary: First Mining Gold Corp. filed a Form 6-K containing its Q2 2026 financial results and operating highlights. The press release covers project milestones including Springpole Gold Project's Federal Environmental Assessment approval, agreements with Indigenous nations, exploration updates at Duparquet, and a joint-venture buy-down at Pickle Crow reducing ownership. This is a routine quarterly update with no special-situation transaction. No merger, tender, activist, or strategic review is announced. The filing is informational and does not trigger a special-situations category.
